caption: Knot: a bend in the wave's wire on its way to the palette - the effect unchanged
why: Wires in a busy graph cross and tangle. Knot is a bend you can put in a number wire, to route it round other nodes - the value passes straight through.

Its neighbours: Knot colour does the same for a colour wire; Send and Receive skip the wire altogether; Knot keeps the wire but steers it. It changes nothing on the LEDs - the picture is the graph's own; the node is for whoever reads the graph.
steps: The **Wave**'s `value` goes into the Knot's **in**, and its `out` on to the **Palette**'s brightness - exactly the same value.
Drag the knot and the wire bends round it.
Double-click a wire in the editor to drop a knot on it.
